actions.title: Check available credits
actions.purpose: See the production workspace’s current credit balance and plan limits.
inputs: The connected Higgsfield production workspace.
actions.output: The latest credit balance and available account allowances.
actions.nextStep: Estimate the exact creative task, then confirm how it will be paid for before starting.

actions.title: Choose a production workspace
actions.purpose: Find the Higgsfield workspace that holds the right team, assets and budget.
inputs: Your connected Higgsfield account.
actions.output: Available production workspaces and your access to each.
actions.nextStep: Choose the workspace for this production before preparing uploads or paid work.

actions.title: Use this production workspace
actions.purpose: Set the Higgsfield workspace for the production you are working on.
inputs: A workspace chosen from your available workspaces.
actions.output: The selected workspace for subsequent Higgsfield activity.
actions.nextStep: Check that its assets and budget belong to this production before continuing.

actions.title: Return to the private workspace
actions.purpose: Return subsequent Higgsfield work to your default private workspace.
inputs: Your decision to leave the currently selected workspace.
actions.output: Your private workspace becomes the context for subsequent work.
actions.nextStep: Check its assets and balance before continuing; no workspace is deleted.

actions.title: Inspect a model’s controls
actions.purpose: Understand what one model needs and what it can produce.
inputs: A model selected from the current catalog.
actions.output: Its available controls, supported references, output formats and limits.
actions.nextStep: Match those requirements to your creative brief before preparing a request.

actions.title: Browse generation models
actions.purpose: Browse the available tools for images, clips, speech and 3D assets.
inputs: The kind of creative work you want to make, with optional search filters.
actions.output: A browsable model catalog.
actions.nextStep: Inspect a model’s controls; being listed does not mean the desktop can run it yet.

actions.title: Find a model for the task
actions.purpose: Find models suited to a particular look or production task.
inputs: A description of the result you want and any format preferences.
actions.output: Matching models from the current catalog.
actions.nextStep: Compare their reference requirements, limits and cost before choosing.

actions.title: Compare suitable models
actions.purpose: Shortlist models for a creative brief.
inputs: Your intended result, available references and output needs.
actions.output: Suggested models to compare.
actions.nextStep: Review the suggestions and qualify a small example before committing production work.

actions.title: Estimate frame cost
actions.purpose: Plan the cost of creating a frame or image variation.
inputs: Your chosen model, image settings and intended references.
The number of images you want.
actions.output: A credit estimate for that specific image request, including any adjusted settings.
actions.nextStep: Check the effective settings and approve the cost in the intended workspace before generating.

actions.title: Estimate clip cost
actions.purpose: Plan the cost of creating or transforming a clip.
inputs: Your chosen model, clip length, output settings and intended references.
actions.output: A credit estimate for that specific clip request, including any adjusted settings.
actions.nextStep: Confirm the quoted length and settings match the shot, then approve the cost before generating.

actions.title: Prepare a media upload
actions.purpose: Prepare cloud upload destinations for files produced during a supported processing step.
inputs: The names and file types of cloud-generated outputs to preserve.
actions.output: Prepared upload destinations for up to 20 files.
actions.nextStep: Transfer and confirm the actual files before the temporary processing session ends.

actions.title: Import an attached reference
actions.purpose: Bring an attached reference into Higgsfield for later creative work.
inputs: An attached image, video, audio file or document, within the 20 MiB limit.
actions.output: A confirmed reference in the selected Higgsfield workspace.
actions.nextStep: Use it in a supported task; arbitrary desktop-file upload through this helper still needs qualification.

actions.title: Finish a prepared upload
actions.purpose: Finish registering files that have already uploaded successfully.
inputs: The completed uploads and their correct media types.
actions.output: Confirmed files ready for supported Higgsfield reference inputs.
actions.nextStep: Attach the appropriate image, video or audio to the next task; a general document is not a generation reference.

actions.title: Choose existing reference media
actions.purpose: Choose references already retained in your Higgsfield workspace.
inputs: The type of reference you want to browse: images, video, audio or files.
actions.output: A selection of existing media of that type.
actions.nextStep: Choose the specific references needed for the task; browse more only when needed.

actions.title: Develop reusable cast, places and props
actions.purpose: Build or inspect a reusable character, place or prop reference.
inputs: An existing reusable Element, or confirmed images that define a new one.
actions.output: A reusable visual reference for models that support Elements.
actions.nextStep: Wait for it to finish, then check model compatibility; some clip models also require an opening frame.

actions.title: Create or revise a frame
actions.purpose: Create a new frame, visual concept or supported revision from your direction.
inputs: Your look or shot direction, chosen model and output settings.
Confirmed visual references when the model requires them.
actions.output: A tracked image request, followed by candidate frames when it finishes.
actions.nextStep: Check the cost and any changed settings before starting; review and save the returned candidates before selecting one.

actions.title: Plan image alternatives
actions.purpose: Explore several independent image ideas or variations together.
inputs: Up to six complete image briefs, with one image requested for each.
actions.output: Separately tracked image alternatives in the order you planned them.
actions.nextStep: Compare the finished frames and retain your choices; these requests do not depend on one another’s results.

actions.title: Create or transform a clip
actions.purpose: Create a new clip or transform supplied footage with a supported model.
inputs: The action, camera and performance direction, with planned length and output settings.
The opening frame, footage, sound or other references required by the chosen model.
actions.output: A tracked clip request, followed by a candidate take when it finishes.
actions.nextStep: Confirm cost and model limits before starting; review the actual motion, continuity, sound and length before selecting the take.

actions.title: Plan video alternatives
actions.purpose: Explore several independent takes or clip ideas together.
inputs: Up to six complete clip briefs, each with its own required references.
actions.output: Separately tracked candidate clips in the order you planned them.
actions.nextStep: Review each finished take; use a returned result as another clip’s input only after it is available.

actions.title: Create dialogue or narration
actions.purpose: Create spoken dialogue or narration in a selected voice.
inputs: The exact spoken words and a voice chosen from the voice picker.
The chosen speech model and performance settings.
actions.output: A tracked speech request, followed by an audio candidate when it finishes.
actions.nextStep: Check the cost before starting, then review pronunciation, performance and timing; this route does not generate music or sound effects.

actions.title: Plan speech alternatives
actions.purpose: Compare independent dialogue or narration performances.
inputs: Up to six speech briefs, each with exact words and a selected voice.
actions.output: Separately tracked speech alternatives for comparison.
actions.nextStep: Listen to each result and retain the preferred performance; this route is for speech, not music or sound effects.

actions.title: Choose a speaking voice
actions.purpose: Audition and choose a voice for dialogue or narration.
inputs: The intention to choose a speaking voice for this task.
actions.output: Available voices with sample previews.
actions.nextStep: Make a selection in the voice picker and retain that exact choice for the speech request.

actions.title: Change a clip’s voice
actions.purpose: Replace the voice in an existing clip while keeping its visual sequence.
inputs: A confirmed or completed video and the replacement voice you selected.
actions.output: A processed video using the chosen voice.
actions.nextStep: Review intelligibility, performance and synchronization before using it in the edit; confirm the voice’s permitted use separately.

actions.title: Check work in progress
actions.purpose: Check whether requested creative work is still running or ready to review.
inputs: Up to eight tracked requests from this production.
actions.output: Progress, finished results or a reported failure for each request.
actions.nextStep: Open finished work for review; if a request cannot be found, resolve that uncertainty before trying again.

actions.title: Review one returned take
actions.purpose: Open one returned frame, clip, sound or 3D result for review.
inputs: One existing generation result you want to inspect.
actions.output: The result with its available production details.
actions.nextStep: Inspect and retain it, then record your decision separately from the fact that generation finished.

actions.title: Compare returned alternatives
actions.purpose: Compare a set of returned creative alternatives side by side.
inputs: The tracked results you want to compare, in your intended order.
actions.output: An ordered gallery of up to 24 results, shown across pages when needed.
actions.nextStep: Compare the candidates and record your selections; arrival order does not change the planned order.

actions.title: Browse previous creative work
actions.purpose: Find earlier image or video work in your Higgsfield history.
inputs: The kind of previous work you want to review.
actions.output: Previous generations outside Marketing Studio.
actions.nextStep: Open the relevant result and confirm its suitability before reusing it.

actions.title: Review previous campaign work
actions.purpose: Find previous image and video work from Marketing Studio.
inputs: The campaign work you want to review.
actions.output: Previous marketing results in their own history.
actions.nextStep: Compare the work, retain useful candidates and review suitability for the current campaign.

actions.title: Break down a reference video
actions.purpose: Request a scene breakdown of a reference video.
inputs: One confirmed uploaded video or a YouTube link.
actions.output: A tracked analysis request for later scene observations.
actions.nextStep: Wait for the breakdown, then check its observations against the video before using them in planning.

actions.title: Find earlier video breakdowns
actions.purpose: Find a video breakdown that was requested earlier.
inputs: The connected workspace and the earlier analysis you want to locate.
actions.output: Recent video analyses and their progress.
actions.nextStep: Open the relevant breakdown when it is complete.

actions.title: Read a video breakdown
actions.purpose: Read the available scene observations from a video analysis.
inputs: An analysis selected from a submitted request or earlier breakdowns.
actions.output: Analysis progress, completed scene observations or a failure explanation.
actions.nextStep: Compare completed observations with the original video; they do not replace your screenplay or creative decisions.

actions.title: Prepare remote media processing
actions.purpose: Process media with prepared editing, transcription or conversion instructions in a temporary cloud workspace.
inputs: The exact processing instructions, accessible input media and outputs to preserve.
actions.output: Processed files and execution details; files must be transferred to survive the temporary session.
actions.nextStep: Preserve all required outputs before the cloud session ends, then inspect them locally; this does not run on your desktop.
actions.effect: Remote compute with possible filesystem/network effects

actions.title: Choose a narrator-video look
actions.purpose: Browse visual styles for narrator-led videos.
inputs: The visual direction you want to explore.
actions.output: Available style presets and previews.
actions.nextStep: Choose a style before retaining its reference for scene preparation.

actions.title: Retain a selected style reference
actions.purpose: Retain the visual reference for a style you have chosen.
inputs: One style selected from the current narrator-video presets.
actions.output: A style reference saved into your Higgsfield media.
actions.nextStep: Use the retained reference in compatible scene requests; this step adds media to the provider workspace.

actions.title: Build a brand kit
actions.purpose: Gather supplied brand direction into a reusable campaign kit.
inputs: Your brand name, messaging and the other brand details you want retained.
actions.output: A saved brand kit in Higgsfield.
actions.nextStep: Review the retained details before using them in campaign work; this does not collect material from a website.

actions.title: Build a product reference
actions.purpose: Turn supplied product images into a reusable marketing reference.
inputs: A product name, confirmed product images and an optional description.
actions.output: A saved product reference for later campaign images or videos.
actions.nextStep: Review the product reference and its permitted use before preparing a campaign.

actions.title: Remove a brand kit
actions.purpose: Permanently delete a selected brand kit from Higgsfield.
inputs: The exact brand kit and an explicit decision to delete it permanently.
actions.output: Confirmation of the deletion.
actions.nextStep: Check the result and choose a remaining kit for future work; do not use this as automatic cleanup.

actions.title: Review a brand kit
actions.purpose: Inspect the details of a selected brand kit.
inputs: The brand kit you want to review.
actions.output: Its retained brand direction and available status.
actions.nextStep: Confirm the details are suitable before using or deliberately revising the kit.

actions.title: Choose an image-ad layout
actions.purpose: Explore layout and style options for campaign images.
inputs: The kind of image campaign you want to make.
actions.output: Available image-ad styles to choose from.
actions.nextStep: Select a supported style, then pair it with your own brand and product references.

actions.title: Choose a campaign presenter
actions.purpose: Browse presenters available for campaign videos.
inputs: Your presenter preferences, with an optional search.
actions.output: Available personal and preset presenters.
actions.nextStep: Choose at most one presenter for a compatible video format; browsing does not create a new presenter.

actions.title: Find brand kits
actions.purpose: Find the brand kit for a campaign.
inputs: The connected marketing workspace.
actions.output: Available brand kits with their summary details.
actions.nextStep: Open the relevant kit and review it before using or changing it.

actions.title: Choose an attention hook
actions.purpose: Find an opening hook for a compatible campaign video.
inputs: The kind of opening you want, with an optional search.
actions.output: Available attention hooks to choose from.
actions.nextStep: Check the video format supports your choice; a separate ad reference may replace hook and setting choices.

actions.title: Choose a product reference
actions.purpose: Find a retained product reference for campaign work.
inputs: The product you want to feature.
actions.output: Available product references in the marketing workspace.
actions.nextStep: Choose your actual product reference; example products shown elsewhere are not automatically yours to use.

actions.title: Choose a campaign setting
actions.purpose: Browse settings for a compatible campaign video.
inputs: The environment or situation you want, with an optional search.
actions.output: Available campaign settings to choose from.
actions.nextStep: Check the chosen format and other references allow the setting before preparing the video.

actions.title: Choose a campaign video format
actions.purpose: Explore campaign video formats and their creative examples.
inputs: The type of campaign video you want to make.
actions.output: Available formats, previews and stated length limits.
actions.nextStep: Choose a format and validate its current limits using your own references; example videos do not establish valid settings.

actions.title: Browse retained web products
actions.purpose: Find website-related product records already retained in Higgsfield.
inputs: The retained product you want to locate.
actions.output: Available web-product records.
actions.nextStep: Inspect and choose a relevant record; this does not visit websites or create new product records.

actions.title: Revise a brand kit
actions.purpose: Replace a brand kit with a reviewed, complete revision.
inputs: The selected brand kit and the complete new set of brand details.
actions.output: The revised brand kit stored in Higgsfield.
actions.nextStep: Include every detail you want to keep: this replaces the whole kit rather than updating only changed fields.

actions.title: Start an editable 3D set
actions.purpose: Create a named, editable set in Higgsfield’s cloud Blender workspace.
inputs: A descriptive set name and the decision to create a new cloud project.
actions.output: A new cloud 3D project for later scene work.
actions.nextStep: Inspect the created project before editing; if creation is uncertain, locate it before retrying. Local Blender is separate.

actions.title: Review a scene render
actions.purpose: Retrieve an existing render or other output from a cloud scene edit.
inputs: The selected cloud set and an output recorded by a specific scene edit.
actions.output: A temporary download of the existing output.
actions.nextStep: Retain the file before the link expires, then inspect it; retrieving an output does not create a new render.

actions.title: Prepare editable Blender delivery
actions.purpose: Retrieve an editable Blender file from a committed cloud scene revision.
inputs: The selected cloud set and the committed revision you want.
actions.output: A temporary download of the editable Blender file.
actions.nextStep: Save it before the link expires and open it in Blender; finish any active cloud edit first.

actions.title: Prepare portable scene delivery
actions.purpose: Retrieve a portable 3D file from a committed cloud scene revision.
inputs: The selected cloud set and the committed revision you want.
actions.output: A temporary download of the portable 3D scene.
actions.nextStep: Save and inspect it in the destination app; lighting and procedural materials may differ from the Blender scene.

actions.title: Check a scene edit
actions.purpose: Check the outcome of a specific cloud scene edit.
inputs: The cloud set and the edit already submitted to it.
actions.output: Edit progress, a committed revision and available outputs, or a failure state.
actions.nextStep: Wait for the edit to settle before changing the scene again; resolve uncertainty before retrying.

actions.title: Inspect the selected set
actions.purpose: Review the state of a selected cloud 3D set.
inputs: The cloud set you want to inspect.
actions.output: Its current revision, active edit and available outputs.
actions.nextStep: Confirm the intended revision before further work; the current connection does not expose every geometry-inspection helper.

actions.title: Place a catalog prop or model
actions.purpose: Place a selected catalog prop or model into a cloud set.
inputs: The chosen cloud set, an asset returned by catalog search and its placement.
actions.output: A tracked import that adds the asset when it finishes.
actions.nextStep: Wait for the import and inspect the placement before another edit; check an uncertain result instead of importing a duplicate.

actions.title: Choose an existing 3D set
actions.purpose: Find an existing editable set in your cloud 3D workspace.
inputs: The set you want to continue working on.
actions.output: Accessible cloud sets with summary details.
actions.nextStep: Choose the exact set for each scene action; this does not switch or open local Blender projects.

actions.title: Direct an editable scene change
actions.purpose: Apply a prepared scene change inside cloud Blender.
inputs: The chosen cloud set, its exact current revision and the complete editing instructions.
actions.output: A tracked edit, then a committed revision and any outputs the instructions publish.
actions.nextStep: Run one scene edit at a time, inspect the result and preserve needed files; some scene-display helpers are not available through this connection.

actions.title: Find a prop or set asset
actions.purpose: Find catalog props and models suitable for a cloud set.
inputs: The chosen cloud set and a description of the asset you need.
actions.output: Available catalog assets with the details needed to import them.
actions.nextStep: Choose an asset, then place it deliberately; search results are not objects already present in your scene.

modelPresets.title: Create an opening frame
modelPresets.purpose: Generate the still needed to begin a shot; an existing video opening is not a prerequisite.

modelPresets.title: Explore a character or costume
modelPresets.purpose: Create reference candidates for casting and look development; preserve source text when linked.

modelPresets.title: Design a place or prop
modelPresets.purpose: Build world, location and prop concepts for any project.

modelPresets.title: Revise a reference image
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare an instruction-based still revision without a mask route.

modelPresets.title: Enhance a still image
modelPresets.purpose: Supply one original and choose actual output dimensions; facial changes remain reviewable.

modelPresets.title: Isolate a still subject
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare one source image for background removal.

modelPresets.title: Create a clip from directions
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare a prompt-only clip without inventing a starting image.

modelPresets.title: Animate an opening frame
modelPresets.purpose: Use the actual selected opening and ordered shot directions.

modelPresets.title: Direct camera and genre
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare observed cinema controls; custom multishot schema is not exposed.

modelPresets.title: Revise an existing clip
modelPresets.purpose: Source runtime drives video-edit duration; no invented target duration or aspect ratio.

modelPresets.title: Continue an existing clip
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare a forward extension from exactly one selected source video.

modelPresets.title: Transfer a performance or camera move
modelPresets.purpose: One driving video plus one or more reference images.

modelPresets.title: Replace a subject in a clip
modelPresets.purpose: One source video and replacement reference images; inspect actual output for continuity.

modelPresets.title: Synchronize dialogue to picture
modelPresets.purpose: Choose a mismatch-handling sync mode deliberately; source video and audio are both required.

modelPresets.title: Enhance video resolution
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare a measured source clip and enhancement settings.

modelPresets.title: Reduce clip flicker
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare one existing clip; source duration and output quality remain measured evidence.

modelPresets.title: Isolate a moving subject
modelPresets.purpose: Prepare one source clip for background removal; no mask input is fabricated.

modelPresets.title: Create dialogue or narration
modelPresets.purpose: Choose an exact voice ID/type pair; keep exact approved spoken text.

modelPresets.title: Direct expressive speech
modelPresets.purpose: Choose a provider voice and style instruction; this is cloud Qwen speech, not local assistance.

modelPresets.title: Choose a speech engine
modelPresets.purpose: Select an engine variant and real voice ID/type pair.

modelPresets.title: Create a campaign image
modelPresets.purpose: Choose an actual ad style and brand/product references; no style default or user-asset IDs are invented.

modelPresets.title: Create a promotional video
modelPresets.purpose: Choose a format and actual marketing assets for a title, brand or product.

modelPresets.title: Explore 3D asset generation
modelPresets.purpose: Discovery only: this model catalog is separate from remote scene editing; no generate_3d function is callable.

modelPresets.title: Explore music and sound models
modelPresets.purpose: Discovery only: installed speech generation does not support music or sound effects.
